The Marsriva MR-US2KRT Energy Efficient 2kVA Rack Mount Online UPS is a high-performance power backup solution designed for servers, network equipment, data centers, and critical business applications. Featuring advanced online double-conversion technology, this UPS delivers continuous pure sine wave power and protects connected devices from power outages, voltage fluctuations, surges, and electrical disturbances.


With a 2kVA/2kW capacity and 0ms transfer time, the MR-US2KRT ensures uninterrupted operation of mission-critical equipment. Its rack-mount 2U design makes it ideal for server rooms, telecom installations, enterprise networks, and IT infrastructure. The UPS also offers high energy efficiency, intelligent battery management, and comprehensive communication interfaces for easy monitoring and control.


Available at OTECH BD, the Marsriva MR-US2KRT provides reliable power protection, enhanced equipment safety, and improved operational continuity for professional environments.


Key Features

  • 2kVA / 2kW Online Double Conversion UPS
  • Pure Sine Wave Output
  • Output Power Factor 1.0
  • 0ms Transfer Time for Critical Applications
  • Energy Efficient Operation up to 95.5%
  • Wide Input Voltage Range
  • Intelligent Battery Management System
  • LCD Display for Real-Time Monitoring
  • Rack Mount 2U Design
  • RS232 and USB Communication Ports
  • Emergency Power Off (EPO) Support
  • Overload and Short Circuit Protection
  • Suitable for Servers, Switches, Routers, Storage Systems, and Data Centers
